hero.title:
Trail running, nature and relaxation
in the heart of the Sierra Calderona.
hero.lead: A small-scale weekend for active people who want to experience more and perform less.

intro.title:
This weekend isn't about performing.
It's about experiencing.
paragraphs: For us, trail running isn't about speed or competition. It's about being outdoors, moving in nature, and noticing what happens once you step away from the rush of everyday life.

In the Sierra Calderona we run by feel. No strict schedule, no focus on times or performance. We stop where it's beautiful, look out over the valley, take a photo, or simply stand still in nature for a moment.

Trail run or hike? The choice is yours. You choose a trail running weekend or a hiking weekend in advance. That way you experience the whole weekend with a group that shares the same pace and the same activity. Whether you love to run or would rather take in the scenery on foot, the experience always comes first. We stay together as a group.

features.title: Who is this weekend for?
paragraphs: This weekend is meant for active people who love being outdoors. You can join as a trail runner or as a hiker. No experience is required, but a good base level of fitness is important. We therefore ask trail runners to be able to run comfortably for at least an hour and a half, and hikers to be able to walk for at least three hours on hilly terrain.
The group has a maximum of six participants. It's exactly this small scale that allows for personal guidance, attention for everyone and a relaxed atmosphere.
Whether you come on your own or with someone else, you are very welcome. Together we'll make it a sporty, relaxed and inspiring weekend, with nature, movement and good company at its heart.
features.statement: Not about performing, but about experiencing it together.

features.title: A villa with a pool
features.text: You'll be staying in my detached villa in El Pinar, a quiet spot in the middle of nature with a pool, spacious terraces and views of the mountains. The neighbourhood itself lies about half an hour inland from Valencia, surrounded by orange groves — wonderfully fragrant blossom in spring and bright orange fruit later in the year. The perfect place to fully unwind after a day on the trails.

features.title: Pine forests & rolling mountain trails
features.text: We run through breathtaking landscapes: fragrant pine forests, rolling mountain trails and surprising little paths you'd never find on your own. Every route has its own atmosphere and pace.

features.title: Views you won't forget any time soon
features.text: The highlight: your first confident trail run through the Spanish landscape. With viewpoints over ravines, valleys and rock formations that stay with you long after you're back home.

features.title: Sport, rest & good company
features.text: A perfect combination of physical challenge, relaxation and connection. After the trails: good food, good conversation, and time to enjoy each other's company. All of it is entirely optional. If you'd rather have some time to yourself once you're back at the villa, feel free to do your own thing. There's room for both.

gallery.title: The Sierra Calderona, up close
gallery.text: Mountain trails through pine forest, canyons with running water and a villa with views of the mountains. Tap any photo to view it full size.

program.title: Three days, three routes
program.text: Each day has its own character, from a gentle start to the highlight of the weekend and a relaxed recovery loop to enjoy the afterglow.

days.label: Friday
days.name: Casinos Discovery Loop
days.text: A relaxed start. We explore the trails around Casinos and get a feel for the terrain. The perfect first loop to loosen up the legs, discover the surroundings and get to know each other.

schedule.title: Pick-up Valencia Airport
schedule.text: You can pick a flight that lands at Valencia Airport around 13:00. Would you rather arrive earlier? You can also take an early morning flight or even come a day ahead. That gives you plenty of time to explore Valencia on your own and enjoy its lively atmosphere, beautiful squares and excellent restaurants. The trip officially starts with the group transfer. If you're joining it, make sure you're back at the airport around 13:00 so we can head to our destination together.

schedule.title: Welcome in Casinos
schedule.text: You arrive at the villa in El Pinar, where you can settle in at your own pace. Take your time to meet the other participants, enjoy a light lunch on the terrace and let the journey fall away.

schedule.title: Discovery Trail
schedule.text: We open the weekend with a relaxed trail run around Casinos. A beautiful route over rolling paths and through pine forests, at an easy pace with plenty of time for the first views.

schedule.title: Dinner together
schedule.text: After the trail we sit down to a healthy, flavourful meal. A relaxed evening to get to know each other better.

days.label: Saturday
days.name: Serra Calderona Grand Loop
days.text: The heart of the weekend: a longer route through breathtaking landscapes and past viewpoints you won't soon forget. Walking is always allowed.

schedule.title: Breakfast
schedule.text: We start the day with a generous, nourishing breakfast so everyone has enough energy for the finest trail of the weekend.

schedule.title: Departure for the main trail
schedule.text: The impressive route through the Sierra Calderona, over varied mountain paths, through fragrant pine forests and past spectacular viewpoints. Along the way we take time for photos and lunch together out in nature.

schedule.title: Back at the villa
schedule.text: Time to unwind: a refreshing dip in the pool, a book on the terrace, or simply the quiet and the view over the mountains.

schedule.title: Dinner together
schedule.text: Another healthy, flavourful meal and a relaxed evening, looking ahead to tomorrow's trail.

days.label: Sunday
days.name: Rebalsadors Recovery Loop
days.text: A calmer finish along ravines and waterfalls, with plenty of time to soak it all in before heading home.

schedule.title: Breakfast
schedule.text: One more breakfast together before we head into the mountains for a relaxed close to the weekend.

schedule.title: Morning trail
schedule.text: A varied route through the Sierra Calderona where we enjoy the quiet, the nature and the wide views one last time.

schedule.title: Lunch together
schedule.text: Back at the villa we close the weekend with a convivial lunch on the terrace. A lovely moment to share experiences and savour it all.

schedule.title: Farewell and airport transfer
schedule.text: After a weekend full of nature, sport, relaxation and new encounters we say goodbye, with fresh energy, inspiration and perhaps a new love for trail running.

villa.title: Villa El Pinar, near Casinos
paragraphs: During this weekend you won't stay in a hotel, but in an atmospheric, detached villa that feels like a home away from home, in the quiet urbanisation of El Pinar, right next to the authentic village of Casinos.

The villa sits amid greenery with views over the mountains of the Sierra Calderona. After a day on the trails you unwind by the pool, on the terrace or in the garden. Inside, it's all about a warm, homely atmosphere: coffee in the morning, stories after the trail run, and healthy, wholesome meals without any rush.

host.title: Maurizio Salazar
paragraphs: My name is Maurizio Salazar and I live for part of the year in the beautiful surroundings of Casinos, at the foot of the Sierra Calderona.

By profession I'm a sports and shiatsu therapist, and I've been fascinated by movement, health and the power of nature my whole life. Sport has always played an important role for me. Whether it's running, trail running, hiking or any other kind of movement, I believe being active is good not only for the body but for the mind as well.

Through my work I'm in daily contact with people who want to live healthier, stronger and with more energy. It shows me again and again how important it is to step out of your daily routine now and then and make time for yourself.
Nature has always been the place where I recharge. In the mountains of the Sierra Calderona I find calm, freedom and adventure. That feeling is what I want to share with others.

Out of that passion came the idea of organising small-scale trail running weekends. Not a performance-driven sports trip, but an accessible experience where movement, nature, relaxation and connection take centre stage.

I'd like to invite you to discover the trails, the surroundings and the relaxed Spanish way of life. Together we enjoy beautiful routes, healthy meals, good conversation and the unique atmosphere of my home in El Pinar.

pricing.title: Choose your weekend
pricing.text: Both weekends are fully organised, from airport transfers to guidance along the way.
pricing.note: A special rate for this first edition. This price applies as long as spots are available.
included: Airport transfer to and from Valencia Airport

practical.title: Good to know
practical.text: The most important practical information at a glance. The full terms and conditions are further below.

faq.a: Open to anyone aged 18 or over with a good base level of fitness. We therefore ask trail runners to be able to run comfortably for at least an hour and a half, and hikers to be able to walk for at least three hours on hilly terrain. You are responsible for assessing your own physical condition and health. The group is kept deliberately small, so there's room for personal attention.
Accommodation at the villa, 2x breakfast, 3x lunch and 2x dinner, coffee, tea and water, airport transfer to and from Valencia Airport, transfers and guidance on every trail run or hike.

During the trail running weekend you stay in our characterful villa in El Pinar, surrounded by the nature of Casinos. You sleep in a shared twin room or, if you prefer to be closer to nature, in a comfortable glamping tent among the pine trees, also suitable for two people.
faq.a2: Whether you choose the villa or the glamping tent, you'll enjoy a calm, homely setting where relaxation, comfort and nature come together. A wonderful place to fully recharge after a day on the trails.

faq.a: A valid basic travel insurance policy is required to join our trips. Check your policy conditions carefully in advance to see whether mountain walking and mountain trails are covered. If they are not, you'll need to arrange additional cover yourself.
faq.a2: Additional baggage insurance, cancellation insurance or other extra cover is not required. Taking these out is a personal choice and the participant's own responsibility.
faq.a3: We'd like to receive a copy of each participant's insurance policy sheet before the trip begins, so we can check that the insurance requirement has been met.
faq.tip: Tip: if in doubt, contact your insurer to verify that the activities during the trip, such as mountain walking, are fully covered.

faq.a: If you cancel your participation, the following costs apply, calculated from the departure date:
faq.note: No refund of the trip price is given for early termination of the weekend, failure to show up on the departure date, or failure to meet the compulsory travel insurance requirement. Up to two days before departure you may nominate a replacement participant free of charge, provided this is reported in advance and approved by the organisation. For cancellation or early termination for personal reasons, you can choose to take out cancellation insurance in addition to your travel insurance, so you can cover this financial risk.

faq.a: Routes, activities or parts of the programme may be adjusted due to weather conditions, wildfire risk, local regulations or other safety considerations.
faq.a2: If the organisation cancels the weekend in advance due to force majeure or safety reasons, you'll receive the full trip price back. The cost of your travel to and from Valencia is not part of the trip price and is not reimbursed by the organisation. To limit this risk, we advise you to book a flexible ticket, or one that allows a date change, where possible.
faq.a3: Flight cancellations, delays and other travel disruptions beyond the organisation's control are not the organisation's responsibility, whatever the cause. This includes strikes, extreme weather, technical failures, traffic problems and situations where a participant cannot reach the airport in time. If you arrive late, we'll still arrange an airport transfer where reasonably possible, scheduled so that the other participants are inconvenienced as little as possible.
faq.a4: No later than four weeks before departure we determine whether there are enough participants for the weekend to go ahead. The minimum group size is four participants. If there are too few, the weekend is cancelled. This gives participants as much certainty as possible about the weekend going ahead before they book their flight, barring force majeure and unforeseen circumstances.

terms.title: 1. Applicability
terms.text: These terms apply to all bookings and participation in the Trail Running & Hiking Weekend Sierra Calderona, organised by Wildcore Retreats. By registering, the participant agrees to these terms.

terms.title: 2. Participation
terms.text: Participation is open to persons aged 18 and over. The participant declares to be in sufficiently good health to take part in trail running and hiking activities and is responsible for assessing their own physical condition. The organiser reserves the right to refuse participation if deemed necessary for the safety of the participant or the group.

terms.title: 3. Bookings and payment
terms.text: A booking is final upon receipt of the deposit or full payment. The remaining balance must be paid no later than 30 days before departure. If payment is not received on time, the organiser may cancel the reservation.

terms.title: 4. Cancellation by the participant
terms.text: Up to 8 weeks before departure: €50 administration fee. From 8 to 4 weeks before departure: 50% of the trip price. From 4 to 2 weeks before departure: 75% of the trip price. Within 14 days before departure: 100% of the trip price. No refund is given for early termination of the weekend or failure to show up on the departure date. Participants are advised to take out travel and cancellation insurance.
terms.text2: Replacement participant: a participant may, up to 7 days before departure, nominate a replacement participant free of charge, provided the organiser is notified in advance, the replacement participant meets the participation conditions, and any additional costs resulting from the change are reimbursed.

terms.title: 5. Cancellation by the organiser
terms.text: The organiser reserves the right to cancel the weekend in case of insufficient participants, force majeure, extreme weather conditions or unforeseen safety risks. In that case, the amount already paid will be fully refunded. Any other costs, such as transport or insurance, fall outside the organiser's responsibility.

terms.title: 6. Risk and liability
terms.text: Trail running, hiking and outdoor activities carry inherent risks. Participation is entirely at your own risk. The organiser is not liable for injuries, accidents, loss, theft or damage to personal property, except in cases of intent or gross negligence. The participant remains responsible for their own actions at all times.

terms.title: 7. Conduct and safety
terms.text: Participants are expected to follow the guide's instructions, treat fellow participants, the accommodation and nature with respect, and avoid taking unacceptable risks during activities. The organiser may exclude a participant from further participation if their behaviour endangers the safety or wellbeing of the group.

terms.title: 8. Programme changes
terms.text: The organiser reserves the right to adjust routes, activities, timings or parts of the programme due to weather conditions, wildfire risk, local regulations or safety considerations.

terms.title: 9. Insurance
terms.text: Every participant is responsible for valid travel insurance, any cancellation insurance, and suitable sports cover if desired.

terms.title: 10. Photo and video material
terms.text: Photos and videos may be taken during the weekend for promotional purposes. If a participant objects to this, they must state so in writing in advance.

terms.title: 11. Personal data
terms.text: Personal data is used solely for organising and running the event and will not be shared with third parties without consent, unless necessary for carrying out the trip.

terms.title: 12. Force majeure
terms.text: Force majeure means any situation beyond the organiser's reasonable control, including natural disasters, wildfires, pandemics, strikes, government measures and extreme weather conditions. In such situations the programme may be adjusted, postponed or cancelled.
